answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a refundable stake that scales with the accounts it controls, like a toll carved into canyon rock. Creating one falcon costs little, but ten thousand fake falcons need ten thousand separate deposits, each slashable if graders catch coordinated fraud. An opal badge is earned only after the stake survives a full epoch unchallenged, so mass Sybils tie up real capital and risk total loss, while honest agents recover their bond.
